items.title: Anthropic goes public and closes its first trading day near a $1.76 trillion valuation
items.summary: Shares priced at $83, opened sharply higher, and finished the day about 17% above the IPO price, making it one of the largest market debuts for an AI company.

items.title: Google says schools can't keep Search without its AI features, and some districts are pushing back
items.summary: Large districts such as New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago are weighing other search engines, and LAUSD says it has turned off AI Overviews while it reviews whether the tools support learning.

items.title: Parents and teachers protest Google's push of AI tools into classrooms
items.summary: Demonstrations outside Google offices in seven cities reflect growing worry among families and educators about how quickly AI products are entering K-12 schools.

items.title: Sarasota adopts a district AI policy as students call it too vague
items.summary: High school students told the board the guidelines do not say what teachers should or should not use AI for, a gap many districts are still working to close.

items.title: Google releases Gemini 4 Neon, a fast model priced for everyday tasks
items.summary: The new model targets quick work in coding, writing and science at a lower price, and early benchmark reports place it near the top tier.
